settings.hero_desc: A detailed miniature of an industrial valve with actuator, finished in your branding and presented in a clear case. A premium branded gift and keepsake for valve makers and engineering firms.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your valve, colours, branding and case
settings.s1_body: A miniature of your own valve is a gift clients actually keep. We reproduce the valve and actuator in detail, finished in your colours and branding and cased for protection - here marked 'Designed, Engineered & Manufactured in UAE'. Produced in matched batches, it's the ideal premium handout for exhibitions, meetings and corporate gifting.
settings.case_body: Produced as branded miniatures for Samantha Valve, a valve manufacturer, these cased models became the most-wanted handout at exhibitions - kept on desks long after the show, quietly carrying the brand.
settings.case_quote: Our most popular giveaway at the exhibition. Clients display them proudly with our branding.
settings.prov_p: A flyer is binned; a detailed miniature of your product is kept. As a branded gift, it carries your name far longer than any brochure.
